title: Procedural Preview Infinite World
description: Extract brep kernel into @geometry/brep/js, setup @procedural/react flow-based brep editor with R3F viewport, and @procedural/play playground.
summary: Fixed procedural 3D viewport zoom/pan usability. Root causes: (1) marquee handlers on the outer wrapper could leave orbit permanently disabled when pointer-up happened outside the div; (2) setOrbitEnabled(false) during marquee gated all orbit controls including wheel zoom; (3) mesh pointerDown stopped propagation for all mouse buttons, blocking middle-mouse pan over geometry. Moved marquee to canvas-level WorldEventBindingController with window pointerup/cancel (matching puzzle 3d), removed orbit gating during marquee, and only stopPropagation on left-button mesh picks.
